data.name: Bay Village
data.headline: Visit one of Boston's hidden neighborhoods with residential charm amidst the surrounding city
data.description:
## Duration, Distance, Terrain
1.5 hours
1 mile at a moderate pace, stopping at various sites along the tour

## About
Visit one of Boston's hidden neighborhoods, an area that has maintained its residential charm amidst the surrounding city. This tour begins behind the Park Plaza Hotel, at Statler Park, overlooking the renaissance and classical revival buildings constructed on the site of the old Boston & Providence Railroad and also features the First Corps of Cadets Armory and the Pope Manufacturing Building.

Originally called the Bay Street District, Bay Village was created by the filling of the mud flats leading into the Back Bay during the 1820s and settled by artisans and craftsmen, many of whom worked on the homes of Beacon Hill and the South End. The scaled-down brick Federal and Greek Revival row houses contribute to the sense of a small community within a larger urban environment.

In the early 20th century, Bay Village was the center of the New England film industry and was known as “Hollywood East." The Cocoanut Grove, a local nightclub and former speakeasy, burned in a fire killing 492 people becoming the second worst single-building fire in U.S. history.

Explore the history and architecture of Bay Village, a small harmonious neighborhood alongside Boston's growing skyline.
## Meeting location:
Meet your guide at the fountain in Statler Park on Columbus Ave and Stuart St.

Finding Your Guide: All guides carry an 8×11 sign that says “Boston By Foot Walking Tours.”

## What to bring
Comfortable shoes, dress for the weather, water bottle
data.cancellation_notes:
- Please arrive at least 10 minutes early to meet your guide. Late admittance is not guaranteed. 
- Public tours can be rebooked on another available tour, or canceled for full credit as a gift card, with at least 24hrs notice. Customers can conveniently cancel or rebook public tour registrations using the "change booking" and "cancel booking" links in the confirmation and reminder emails. Cancellations less than 24hrs prior to the tour start or no shows cannot be credited.
- Private tours can be canceled up to 4 days before the start for a full refund. Private tour cancellations made within 4 days of the tour date incur a small cancellation fee, though they can be rebooked for no additional fees. Contact us to cancel or rebook a private tour. 
- All tours are held in all weather - rain or shine. Please be prepared for the weather and to walk and stand outdoors on your tour. In case of tour cancellation by Boston By Foot due to extreme weather or unforeseen circumstances, you will be offered a refund or exchange. If groups choose to cancel a tour due to weather, the above policy stands.
